save_delayed_memory.description: Allows the model to save a delayed memory report.
rules: Use this marker only after the user explicitly asks to create/save a delayed memory report or explicitly accepts a proposal to consolidate L4 facts into delayed memory.
Skip save_delayed_memory when the user request is to save session or load an already existing delayed memory report.
Emit the fulfilled form inside the marker:
You must fulfill title, summary, tags, and body so the report is valid for runtime processing.
When the report consolidates facts from <LONG_TERM_MEMORY>, classify each referenced F<number> id as either anchor or absorbed.
anchor_fact_ids are important atomic facts that must remain directly visible in <LONG_TERM_MEMORY>; while the report exists they receive a [ delayed_memory_id: ... ] suffix.
absorbed_fact_ids are details represented by the report and are hidden from <LONG_TERM_MEMORY> while the report exists.
Use exact ids copied from the [ id: ... ] suffixes. Do not list unrelated ids and never use PF pending ids.
A fact id must not be present in both arrays. Leave both arrays empty when the report does not consolidate L4 facts.
DO NOT add any other text while making a report. Do not notify or acknowledge saving; immediately emit only the marker.
